observed_in: Pet and Companion System failure analysis

definition: When companions become too strong compared to the player, they trivialize combat and exploration, leading to a lack of challenge and engagement. Players may rely solely on companions, diminishing the importance of player skill and strategy.
exclusion_criteria: companions are balanced with player abilities
companions require active management from the player
inclusion_criteria: companions consistently defeat enemies without player input
player feels no need to engage in combat
title: Overpowered Companions
